name: poolindex-desktop
author: Lior Elbaz, Israel
description: PoolIndex desktop client. Wallet checks run on this PC. No server secrets.

scripts.dist: npm run bundle:engine && npm run check-secrets && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run bundle:engine && npm run check-secrets && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle:engine && npm run check-secrets && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
